title: [Subcontracting] Bug 648949: Allow subcontracting direct transfers from warehouse locations
summary: Subcontracting now allows direct transfers from warehouse-enabled source locations by removing an obsolete outbound warehouse guard in the transfer order creation report.
key_points: Removed outdated validation that rejected warehouse-enabled transfers
Retained posting-mode selection and in-transit-code preservation from earlier changes
Added comprehensive test scenarios for various warehouse configurations (Require Shipment, Inventory Pick, Directed Put-away and Pick)
Tests verify component quantities, bin balances, and shipment/receipt quantities
Correction applies only to main/29, not to 28.x releases
